inputs.resume_text:
SNEHA PILLAI
PGP 2026-28, Indian Institute of Management Kozhikode
sneha.pillai@iimk.ac.in

EDUCATION
PGP, IIM Kozhikode, 2026-28, CGPA 5.9/10 (Term 1)
B.Sc. Biotechnology, Christ University, Bengaluru, 2026, 8.1/10
Class XII (CBSE), Kendriya Vidyalaya Pattom, 2023, 91%

INTERNSHIPS
Biocon Biologics | Research Intern | May - Jul 2025
- Assisted in stability testing of 2 biosimilar formulations; documented 60+ test runs
- Prepared a literature summary on cold-chain failures in insulin distribution in South India
Nature's Basket (Godrej) | Retail Marketing Intern, Kochi | Dec 2024 - Jan 2025
- Ran in-store sampling for an organic millet range across 3 outlets; sampling footfall converted at 18% vs 11% for the shelf-only week
- Collected feedback from 150 shoppers and suggested Malayalam shelf talkers, which were printed for the Kochi stores

POSITIONS OF RESPONSIBILITY
- Head, Cultural Committee, Christ University (2024-25): led a 25-member team for the annual fest with a footfall of 8,000
- Volunteer, Kerala flood relief collection drive, 2024

SKILLS AND INTERESTS
- Excel, Canva, basic R
- Classical Carnatic vocalist; Malayalam, Tamil, Hindi, English

claims.text: Assisted in stability testing of 2 biosimilar formulations; documented 60+ test runs
Prepared a literature summary on cold-chain failures in insulin distribution in South India

Head, Cultural Committee, Christ University (2024-25): led a 25-member team for the annual fest with a footfall of 8,000

concerns.detail: The candidate is moving from biotechnology and scientific research into marketing.

plan.warmup_question: What has kept you busy in your studies over the last few weeks?
plan.background_question: Walk me through your background, from your biotechnology degree through your internships, and what you've focused on since starting your MBA.

slots.core_question: You are moving from biotechnology into marketing. What is pulling you toward marketing?
slots.intent_private: Needs a reason grounded in Sneha's own biotechnology, retail internship or MBA experience, plus something specific about the marketing work she wants to pursue.
likely_probes: What in your experience at Nature's Basket made marketing appealing?
What have you done in the MBA so far to explore marketing?
What other roles or companies are you considering alongside marketing?

slots.core_question: What were you trying to solve when you ran in-store sampling for Nature's Basket?
slots.intent_private: Needs the business objective, Sneha's specific actions in the three outlets, how the 18% versus 11% comparison was measured, and what she personally concluded from it.
likely_probes: Which parts of the sampling activity were your responsibility?
What decision did you make that shaped the sampling approach?
What was the 18% conversion rate compared with in the underlying data?

slots.core_question: Tell me about a time you disagreed with your team or took a stance.
slots.intent_private: Needs a specific disagreement from college, an internship or the MBA, Sneha's position and actions, and what changed because she took that stance.
likely_probes: What was your position in that disagreement?
How did you decide which view to support?
What changed after you took that stance?

slots.core_question: What was the hardest part of leading the cultural committee at Christ University?
slots.intent_private: Needs a concrete leadership challenge involving the 25-member team, Sneha's own decisions and actions, and evidence of how the annual fest was delivered.
likely_probes: What decision did you personally make to address that challenge?
How did you handle a team member who was not meeting expectations?
How did you know the fest reached its reported footfall of 8,000?

plan.plan_notes: The plan prioritizes Sneha's quantified retail marketing result, then covers conviction and teamwork and her substantial student leadership activity, which is important for a summer-placement fresher. The biotechnology-to-marketing switch is raised in motivation, while the low first-term CGPA is covered neutrally through the required MBA background walkthrough rather than as a separate question.
